query:
SELECT product, milestone_name, milestone_date, milestone_type 
FROM milestones 
WHERE milestone_name LIKE '%Launch%' OR milestone_name LIKE '%OSD%' 
ORDER BY milestone_date ASC 
LIMIT 20;
